input.quote: The parties agree to the following non-binding sales and marketing cooperation efforts:
input.rationale: We reviewed the Grant of Rights (Section 2), Shared Resources (Section 13), Exhibit B pricing/revenue sharing and Exhibit D sales and marketing cooperation. No provision obliges Corio to source exclusively from Commerce One, to purchase all of its requirements from Commerce One, or to refrain from licensing or hosting competing procurement/e-commerce software; all licences granted to Corio are expressly "nonexclusive" (running in Commerce One's favour as licensor, which is unobjectionable), and the Exhibit D cooperation commitments (relationship managers, joint marketing, marketing fund, initial customers) are stated to be "non-binding" and do not create any preferred-partner or sole-supplier restriction. Section 2.9's reference to future products is permissive and subject to terms "as the parties may agree", so it imposes no forward purchasing commitment. This meets the preferred position (no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on the customer), so no redline is required. We also note Section 2.4 (Commerce One must refer Corio Customers to Corio) and the MarketSite revenue share operate in our favour and are not flagged.
